title: Read-only Git provider
objective: Expose typed local Git status, diff, and log without generic shell or network authority.

authority_delta.filesystem: Read-only Git metadata/content inside trusted workspaces
authority_delta.process: Internal fixed git executable and fixed subcommands only
authority_delta.secrets: No Cotra/tunnel secret variables inherited by Git

invariants: No generic Git command or shell tool is exposed
Repository root must resolve inside the trusted workspace
Global/system Git config, fsmonitor, pager, external diff, textconv, and terminal prompting are disabled
Git output is bounded and commands time out
No network Git operation is exposed

acceptance.claim: Status reports working tree state without mutation.
Diff is bounded and disables external diff/textconv.
Non-repositories and workspace escapes fail closed.
No client-selected executable, raw argv, shell, or network operation exists.
Windows and Ubuntu exact-head CI pass.

done_when: Exact-head CI and security review pass, PR merges, and post-merge CI is green.
